title: Local Observer State And Identity Preservation
summary: Local sampling and archive operations preserve state, delivery pins and pending observations. The standalone Server is no longer distributed.
localQueueDisposition: Use outbox-export and outbox-verify with an explicit private archive destination. Export and verification do not change the original state, destination, acknowledgements or cursors.
identity: Legacy loopback delivery pins a configured destination and rejects mismatched identities before export. Never silently repin an immutable outbox or discard pending observations to resume delivery.
reconciliation: Read-only reconciliation requires an already persisted destination. It cannot repair local cursors, rewrite pending packets, reconstruct missing history or authorize a new binding.
recovery: Keep the original state and matching binary. Continue local sampling independently. Any fresh state namespace or disposition of an old queue requires an explicit owner decision.
